placements.why: The document's content is fundamentally about a database technology choice — switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB for an analytics pipeline — which is an architecture-level infrastructure decision. No existing strata category covers this, so a new one is minted.
placements.title: infrastructure and technology choices that shape the system

placements.title: performing a database migration as a settled decision with quantified justification
placements.frame: how is a technology migration announced, justified, and scheduled as a settled course of action?
placements.why: All five expressions contribute to the theme of performing and justifying a database migration: src-1 announces the switch in present progressive, src-2 and src-4 provide quantified justification (10x performance, lower cost) as evidence supporting the decision, src-3 records it as a summary header, and src-5 fixes the Q3 2026 timeline. The 10x performance claim is a measurement that evidences the migration theme, not a standalone leaf. No existing leaf holds this subject.
